components.local_changes: Initial deterministic engine, CPU contract and scheduler
Host-independent address-space bus with an optional observer for deterministic external traces
Host-allocated RAM and ROM regions with endian-neutral bus transactions

Replaced global CPU state and legacy memory coupling with explicit state and bus transactions; added tested arithmetic flags, conditional flow, ModR/M effective addresses with explicit ES/CS/SS/DS overrides, memory forms of segment and general-register moves, immediate ADD/AND/CMP and byte TEST/AND operations, near CALL/RET, register and ES stack operations, SHR by CL, LODSW/STOSW/SCASW, ROM-checksum and memory-check paths, full basic-register inspection, and callback-based real-mode interrupt entry to the still-incomplete V30 subset

Replaced global devices, host timers and direct CPU coupling with opaque single-instance components: an 8237 programming and request-state core, its external XT page latches with explicit channel mapping and effective addresses, a single 8259A, a deterministic 8253 and the B0h/B1h interrupt-status/control front of the MM58167 RTC; the RTC counter window, clock progression, alarm, IRQ generation and persistence remain absent, as do DMA transfer ownership and device data movement
Initial opaque session lifecycle and typed machine factory
Deterministic host adapter for tests and headless use
Minimal frontend proving that Qt is optional

Isolated the documented V30, RAM, ROM, 8237 programming core and four-bit XT page registers, single PIC, PIT, MM58167 interrupt-status/control front and minimum motherboard register map behind a typed machine factory; added explicit PIC-to-CPU interrupt routing, early BIOS diagnostic latches, an opaque port-70h memory-control latch and selector-only EMS register boundary, while DMA transfers, the EMS aperture, keyboard queues, the remainder of the RTC and peripherals remain absent
